heading: A fresh perspective. A clearer next step.
audience: Businesses unsure why their site feels confusing

sections.title: Prepare
sections.body: Share your website, goals, and the questions you want to resolve.

sections.title: Review together
sections.body: Walk through content, navigation, mobile usability, and the customer journey.

sections.title: Prioritize
sections.body: Identify the most useful next actions and discuss any implementation needs.

scopeNote: Your final deliverables, timeline, and any external costs are confirmed in a tailored proposal.

faqs.question: Do I need an existing website?
faqs.answer: An existing site helps, but you can also discuss a planned website and the decisions you need to make before building it.

faqs.question: Will you make changes during the call?
faqs.answer: The consultation focuses on review and recommendations. Any implementation is scoped separately unless explicitly agreed.

faqs.question: How long is the session?
faqs.answer: The duration and scope are confirmed when booking.
